BODY FIX #7. Loose motions started... and you're drinking juice or a cold drink? Bro, STOP.
B, ORS. The right salt + sugar mix refills water FAST.
Juice and cold drinks have too much sugar. They can pull more water into the gut.
Fix: Sip ORS often, keep eating light food, wash hands every time.
Red flags: Blood, high fever, no pee, or more than 2 days? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: WHO - ORS / NHS - Diarrhoea
